notes.title: Bug Fix : Steam Deck Loading Time
notes.notes:
Fixed the issue related to excessive loading time on Steam Deck and Proton.
Feel free to tell us if you still experience any issue.

notes.title: Bug Fixes
notes.notes: Fixed the issue related to powers that weren't activated properly when getting a new item.

notes.title: Shield Update !
notes.notes:
New update for After Death !

- Shield System implementation (if you die 3 times in a row without reaching a save, 
you'll be able to get a "shield" that will help you to progress until the next save point).
- Health Adjustment for Final Boss and alternate Final Boss.
- Lowered the dialogue sound effect.
- Fixed the issue with the snow Miniboss "Tortured Puppet". It doesn't reappear once killed.
- Fixed sound sync Issue with the Boss InPulsa in the boat.

notes.title: Sigma update
notes.notes:
The Sigma update is now available :
[list]
[*] Visual and animation improvements for all enemies and Bosses
[*] Visual and animation improvements for player (including all armours and spider behaviour)
[*] Visual and animation improvements for some FXs (weapons, pickups, ennemies chunks, ennemies attacks, player powers, water and waterfalls ...)
[*] Visual improvements on few assets in areas
[*] New visual for the main gate
[*] Minimap improvements (visual and clarity)
[*] Camera smooth feature (always a smooth effect when camera follow the player)
[*] Difficulty adjustments for the crouch skull, ghost crouch skull, boat crouch skull and the first boss
[*] Water distorsion adjustments for underwater levels
[*] Added japanese and chinese translation in the credits
[*] Various Bugs fixes
[/list]

notes.title: Update : Translation.
notes.notes: Japanese and Chinese Localisations are now available for After Death !

notes.title: After Death : Alpha & Omega
notes.notes:
From now, You can see some progress of the Alpha & Omega version on Imgur !
[url=https://imgur.com/user/AfterDeathGame]AfterDeathGame on Imgur[/url]

The Alpha & Omega version is the next big update for After Death including :
- upgraded visual and animations for all enemies and bosses.
- the new difficulty "Alpha & Omega" for a great challenge where Enemies have better attacks.
- some features updates like Camera system, minimap or 60hz for specific situations
- new secret areas
Feel free to comments and share what you see !

notes.title: 16/9 format for After Death !
notes.notes:
We decided to switch from 4:3 to 16:9 based on the request from the players.
This allow to remove the black parts on the sides of the screen without stretching the whole picture.
Distances in levels and the minimap aren't affected by those modifications.

notes.title: 60Hz mode and speed run mode for After Death !
notes.notes:
The 60Hz mode has been added and it is activated by default.
This allow a better smoothness on pixels movements.
The 30Hz mode is still available in the options menu.
The speed-run mode is disabled by default.
Once activated, a counter is displayed at the bottom of the screen. Also, all dialogues are automatically skipped.

notes.title: Patch 1.0.1.4 added !
notes.notes:
- You can now skip cinematics (by default, by pressing Y on gamepad).
- Auto-saves added after each boss fights (exept the final boss).
- Fixes related to achievements (can't touch this).
- Attack rate of the boat worm has been decreased.
- New idle animation for boat worm.

notes.title: New : CRT mode for After Death !
notes.notes:
Merry Christmas Everyone !

There's now a new post-process for After Death : CRT mode !
This is a Beta version but you can already select 3 modes and 3 filters to adjust it as you want.

There's also other updates :
- Compatibility with Steam Cloud.
- Full French translation.
- Bug fixes related to players feedbacks (still working on few ones)
